reference.notes: Die-shot-level YM2608 model built in a sparse isolated checkout. The upstream rhythm-ROM header was excluded and replaced at build time by Chipper's original synthetic bytes. No oracle source or binary is vendored, linked, or shipped with Chipper.

trace.resampleContract: Exact rational clock/144 serial frames converted to 48 kHz with the same accumulator-and-hold schedule as chipper_render.
trace.audibleState: Fixed-region bass drum is routed left and Tom is routed right. The pair covers the YM2608 rhythm /432 and /864 timing domains, canonical high-nibble-first file bytes, fixed inclusive endings, and stereo pan.

candidate.command: chipper_render --chip ym2608 --accuracy authentic --macro manual --clock 7987200 --rate 48000 --seconds 0.2 --events tests/events/ym2608-adpcm-a-reference-events.txt --source1 1 --source2 0 --source3 0 --source4 0 --source5 0 --source6 0 --source7 0 --source8 0 --source9 0 --stereo-spread 0 --output-db 0 --opna-rhythm-rom tests/references/yamaha-adpcm-a-synthetic-opna.bin --out yamaha-adpcm-a-opna-candidate.wav --debug yamaha-adpcm-a-opna-candidate.json

comparison.negativeQualification: tests/qualify_yamaha_adpcm_a_reference.py must reject a nibble-reversed candidate at these thresholds.

covers: independent trusted-emulator regression evidence for YM2608 ADPCM-A decoding
canonical file-byte to physical internal-ROM nibble wiring
fixed bass-drum and Tom ROM windows with inclusive endings
left/right pan routing, duration, gross level, and bounded channel-slot startup skew
